malchStrawPlant.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Make ONE production-quality standalone transparent square icon for the Gredice garden game. The supplied seedling, backpack, and carrot achievement are rendering style references. Follow their chunky beveled low-poly volumes, broad distinct facets, matte toy-like surfaces, warm upper-left light, rich shaded faces, and bold silhouettes. Follow the seedling reference for upright, healthy, uninterrupted stems and simple fresh lime-green leaves. Use dark cocoa earth, honey timber if visible, and golden wheat straw as the mulch. Straw reads as overlapping dense crisscrossed short, thick, flattened dry strands with a few straw pieces jutting out at its edges, easy to read in a 48px thumbnail. Slightly elevated three-quarter view. Operation: applying a golden straw mulch ring around ONLY ONE individual seedling. One intact upright seedling sits centered left on a disk of dark earth. A thick, bright circular ring of golden straw runs around the base, with a narrow visible dark collar of bare soil immediately around the stem. Most of the top of the little plot is already gold. At the upper right, a small olive-green gardening scoop is tipped down and inward over the ring. A short diagonal stream of big golden straw pieces falls directly from its mouth onto the gold ring. Keep the silhouette of the scoop separate from plant leaves and omit any timber planter. The focal image is the completed golden mulch coverage around the plant with the scoop placing the last straw inward. Entire silhouette is contained in the square with 7% clear padding on all sides. True transparent alpha outside the scene. No lettering, numbers, arrows, icons or labels overlaid, no border, people or hands, scenery, extra weeds, flowers, fruit, extraneous objects or shadows outside the art.
malchStrawPlant.export: Center the illustration on a transparent 640 × 640 canvas with 14% padding per edge on the longest axis. Encode as WebP at quality 90.
